scaffold.heading: Citizen Portal
scaffold.subheading: Unified app shell — routes from messages, profile and dashboard land here in Phase B.

help.title: Search for services or information
help.description: Gov.ie is your main access point to government services and information in Ireland. Here, you can find help with things like social welfare, employment, health, education, and housing. The site brings together updates on government policies and emergency announcements, and it makes it easier to find the right department or local office you may need. Whether you're looking for support, applying for services, or just trying to understand your entitlements, this is a good place to start.

paragraph.main: To get the right support, select the option that corresponds to the public service body that sent you the secure message.
paragraph.departmentOfEducation: If you received a notification from <bold>Department of Education and Youth</bold>, select this option to access their support services.
paragraph.departmentOfSocialProtection: If you received a notification from <bold>Department of Social Protection/Welfare.ie</bold>, select this option to access their support services

heading.main: Complete Your MyGovID Account Verification to Proceed

paragraph.safeLevel2: You've already verified your email and phone number, but to use this service, you also need to fully verify your MyGovID account by linking it to your Public Services Card (PPSN). This extra step confirms your identity for secure access to public services. Please follow <link>these instructions</link> to complete the verification process.
